_comment: Listings checked live in the browser on the date below but never scraped into content/reviews/. Without this file verify_quotes.py reports them as unbacked, which is the right default: a card whose price and review count rest on nothing should fail. An entry here is a claim that a human or an agent opened the live page and read the figure off it. Keep the note short and keep 'checked' honest.

proven-ground-53silverado1500-3-inch-sin.name: C&L Single Exhaust System with Polished Tip; Side Exit (14-18 5.3L Silverado 1500)
proven-ground-53silverado1500-3-inch-sin.note: Article carried 268; the live page shows 269.

mbrp-silverado1500-armor-plus-high-flow-.name: MBRP Armor Plus High Flow Replacement Muffler (14-26 4.3L, 5.3L Silverado 1500)
mbrp-silverado1500-armor-plus-high-flow-.note: No per-product review count published; page shows an email-notify box rather than a buy button.

hp-tuners-silverado1500-mpvi4-tuner-8-un.name: HP Tuners MPVI4 Tuner with 8 Universal Credits (22-26 V8 Silverado 1500)
hp-tuners-silverado1500-mpvi4-tuner-8-un.note: Page labels it '37 Reviews of HP Tuners' -- the count is for the brand line, not the MPVI4 alone.

rough-country-silverado1500-350-inch-uca.name: Rough Country 3.50-Inch Forged UCA Lift Kit with N3 Struts and Premium N3 Shocks; Red (19-24 Silverado 1500)
rough-country-silverado1500-350-inch-uca.note: 'Customer Reviews (480)' with no product-line label. The M1 kit and other Rough Country Silverado kits show the same 480, so it is a brand-family pool.

rough-country-silverado1500-350-inch-sus.name: Rough Country 3.50-Inch Suspension Lift Kit with M1 Struts and Rear M1 Monotube Shocks (19-24 Silverado 1500)
rough-country-silverado1500-350-inch-sus.note: Same 480 as the N3 kit above -- brand-family pool, not this part number alone.
